description: Client-only. Capture the current game framebuffer as a PNG image (at the game's current resolution) so a vision-capable model can literally see what the player sees. With marks: true, mobs and players in view get numbered labels (#1, #2, ...) on the image and a legend maps each number to its entity uuid, type and distance, so you can act on "#2" with attack_entity or use_entity.

marks.description: Label the mobs and players in view with numbers and list them.

name: screenshot
title: Capture screenshot
